description: This file defines the StreamHandler class, which implements an HTTP handler that utilizes PHP's stream wrapper to send HTTP requests and process responses within the Guzzle HTTP client library.

classes.name: StreamHandler
classes.description: A final class that handles HTTP requests using PHP's stream wrapper, providing request sending and response creation functionalities.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the process of sending an HTTP request using the stream wrapper, including handling delays, protocol versions, headers, and errors, returning a promise with the response.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the 'on_stats' callback with transfer statistics if specified in the options.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a Guzzle response object from the stream headers and body, wrapping it in a fulfilled promise or rejecting with an exception if an error occurs.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a sink stream for response body data, either returning the provided stream or opening a temporary stream based on options.

methods.name: checkDecode
methods.description: Decodes response content encoding (gzip/deflate) if instructed via options, adjusting headers and stream accordingly.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Drains data from the source stream into the sink stream, respecting the content length header to prevent infinite reads.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Creates and returns a stream resource, handling potential errors during stream resource creation.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream resource for the request based on the scheme, context options, and request headers, supporting various configurations like proxy, timeouts, and SSL options.

methods.name: resolveHost
methods.description: Resolves the host in the request URI, supporting forced IP resolution via DNS lookups.

methods.name: getDefaultContext
methods.description: Generates the default PHP stream context array for the request, including method, headers, SSL options, and body.

methods.name: add_proxy
methods.description: Configures the proxy option and authorization headers based on the provided proxy URL.

methods.name: parse_proxy
methods.description: Parses a proxy URL into components suitable for PHP stream context configuration, including handling basic authentication.

methods.name: add_timeout
methods.description: Adds a timeout setting to the stream context from the request options.

methods.name: add_crypto_method
methods.description: Sets the SSL crypto_method option for the stream context based on the request options.

methods.name: add_verify
methods.description: Configures SSL verification options for the stream context based on the request options.

methods.name: add_cert
methods.description: Adds local certificate and passphrase information to the SSL options in the stream context.

methods.name: add_progress
methods.description: Sets a progress notification callback in the stream options for monitoring transfer progress.

methods.name: add_debug
methods.description: Enables debugging and logging of stream events and notifications.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Utility method to add or chain notification callbacks for stream progress or debug events.

methods.name: callArray
methods.description: Utility method that composes multiple callback functions into a single callable that executes all provided functions sequentially.
